problem_restatements: Harmonic analysis on cyclic groups: characters chi_k(n) = exp(2*pi*i*k*n/p) satisfy chi_k(a+b) = chi_k(a)*chi_k(b). Decompose inputs into character coefficients, combine via homomorphism (pointwise complex multiplication), reconstruct output via inverse character projection.
Periodic demodulation with variable period: s = a+b is a natural number; (a+b) mod p extracts fractional phase relative to period p. A tunable periodic decomposition across 9 periods.
analogy: Matched-filter correlator bank tuned to current period p. Characters are group homomorphisms — addition in group domain becomes pointwise multiplication in frequency domain (finite-group convolution theorem).

ops: prime_modulator: learned lookup table mapping each prime p to K frequency values mu_{k,p}. 9*K parameters, initialized to k/p.
harmonic_projector: maps integer n to 2K-dim vector via (cos(2*pi*n*mu_{k,p}), sin(2*pi*n*mu_{k,p})). No learned parameters. Applied independently to a and b.
phase_adder: pairwise complex multiplication of two 2K-vectors. No learned parameters. Hardwires chi_k(a+b) = chi_k(a)*chi_k(b).
amplitude_weighter: scales each channel k by learned weight w_k. K parameters.
correlation_classifier: for each candidate c, computes score via inverse character projection. Scores for c >= p masked. No additional learned parameters.
plan.composition_strategy: sequential pipeline with parallel fork for two inputs
plan.layer_arrangement: prime_modulator(p) -> harmonic_projector(a,freqs) || harmonic_projector(b,freqs) -> phase_adder -> amplitude_weighter -> correlation_classifier -> masked logits
plan.reasoning: The baseline failure (fast memorization, slow generalization) is missing inductive bias. Harmonic architecture builds character decomposition into the graph. Only ~144 frequency params + 16 amplitude weights needed. Homomorphism hardwired into phase_adder.

expected_outcome: Test accuracy >90% within 5000 epochs. Immediate generalization because architecture encodes group homomorphism. ~160 total parameters vs baseline's 405k.
falsification: If test accuracy below 80% at epoch 5000: harmonic bias insufficient. If small primes don't reach 95%+ by epoch 1000: thesis is wrong. If training accuracy below 95% at epoch 2000: pipeline too rigid.
look_back: If mu_{k,p} = k/p exactly, the composition computes DFT, character multiplication, and inverse DFT — producing a perfect delta at (a+b) mod p.
Generalizes to any finite abelian group operation.
Extreme parameter efficiency (~160 vs 405k) forces algebraic structure learning.
Primary risk: optimization difficulty from periodicity of cos. Mitigate with k/p initialization.
